title: A single-purpose release-notes agent
request:
Build a small agent that turns a list of commit messages into release notes.
Keep its instructions in skills/release-notes.md (a short style guide of your
choosing that mentions "user-facing"). POST /eval-agent-02/notes takes
{"commits": string[]} and answers {"notes": string} by sending the commits and
the instructions to the Anthropic Messages API once, with the key taken from a
secret named ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. A body whose commits is empty or not an array
answers 400. Put the code that builds the model request in lib/prompt.ts as an
exported function buildRequest(commits: string[], instructions: string) and
write tests for it.
